assessment: The study focuses on the role of CISD1 in Parkinson's disease (PD) and its relationship with the PINK1/Parkin pathway. The obtained data provide convincing evidence that apo-CISD1 may have a toxic function in Pink1 mutant flies and in dopaminergic neurons from patients with PINK1 mutation, thus serving as a critical mediator of Pink1-linked PD phenotypes. The findings provide valuable insights into the role of iron homeostasis and mitochondrial biology in PD.
